identity.name: RiverWalk
identity.notes: Gated residential community in West Palm Beach situated along the Intracoastal Waterway near the Riverwalk district and downtown West Palm Beach. Specific HOA fee schedules, amenity details, and census-level demographic data for this community are not reliably documented in my knowledge base, so those fields are left blank rather than estimated.

fees.note: Quarterly Assessment Fees (no dollar amount published). Determined each year during budgeting (starts mid-August, finalized by Board in November), effective January 1; Operating budget + Reserve contributions divided among 1,367 units by home type, then divided by 4. Due Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1; payable via ClickPay auto-pay. Managed by FirstService Residential. Verify current amount with the association/estoppel letter before purchase. City-wide reference only: West Palm Beach townhouse/villa median HOA fee ~$443-485/month (not RiverWalk-specific). Confidence 0.9 (official HOA site). Retrieved 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z (approx).

Capital Contributions are explicitly NOT part of Quarterly Assessment Fees, implying a separate capital contribution charge exists; amount not published on the page. Confidence 0.9 (official HOA site). Retrieved 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z (approx).

amenities.detail: Controlled gated entry; waterfront location along the Intracoastal Waterway near the Riverwalk promenade district.
